## Definition of done

From `AGENTS.md`, *Definition of done*:

- [ ] `nix develop -c scripts/check.sh` ends with `All checks passed`.
- [ ] The program was run and behaved as expected; how:
- [ ] New behaviour is tested; a layout behaviour always is.
- [ ] Budgets the change touches are measured and met, the figures in `docs/measurements.md`.
- [ ] Every document the change affects is updated.
- [ ] A decision a newcomer would question is a proposed ADR, numbered `NNNN`.
- [ ] A change users see has its fragment in `changelog.d/`; a changed contract says what to do
      instead.
- [ ] The commits hold no AI attribution and no personal data.
